name: Broken Pillar
summary: South of Gadgetzan, Marvon Rivetseeker studies artifacts buried in Tanaris’s sands. His research camp stands beside the ancient troll ruins of the Broken Pillar.

sections.title: Sun-Bleached Stone
sections.body: South of Gadgetzan and east of the Abyssal Sands, the Broken Pillar rises from the desert. Tanaris has swallowed much of its ancient troll stonework. Desert beasts roam nearby, yet the ruins still offer clues to the continent’s earliest civilizations. Marvon Rivetseeker, a goblin researcher from Ratchet, has made his camp beside the shattered stones. There he examines Gahz'ridian relics scattered across the waste.

faq.answer: The Broken Pillar is an ancient troll ruin in central Tanaris, south of Gadgetzan and east of the Abyssal Sands. Weathered pillars and debris, half-buried in shifting dunes, are all that remain.

faq.q: Who is camped at the Broken Pillar?
faq.answer: Marvon Rivetseeker, a goblin scientist and prospector from Ratchet, has made a research camp among the ruins. He studies mysterious Gahz'ridian ornaments buried in the surrounding desert.

faq.q: Who built the original ruins here?
faq.answer: Ancient trolls built the ruins. Their stonework dates to the time when troll empires ruled southern Kalimdor, long before desert sands covered the region.

Gahz'ridian are ancient stone artifacts and carved faces buried in Tanaris’s sands. From his camp at the Broken Pillar, Marvon Rivetseeker studies them to uncover the craft and power of the vanished empire.

angles.text: For trolls, the crumbling pillars mark an age of ancestral troll architecture, before time and sand broke the empire’s dominion over southern Kalimdor.
Marvon Rivetseeker’s study of unknown relics reflects gnomish scholarly curiosity, though his methods are distinctly goblin.
